approaches.name: PLP EdTech platform with AI language model for teachers
approaches.description: Project expands the PLP digital learning platform to all primary schools and integrates an AI language model to assist teachers.

evidence.text: BEIP will leverage this work and support expanding the use of the PLP EdTech platform to all primary schools and further integrate the AI language model to assist teachers.

extra_evidence.text: The PLP is a learning platform that provides digital learning content aligned with the national curriculum.
